function.name: list_accounts
function.description: List all registered accounts (logged-in users) in the system

function.name: list_email_accounts
function.description: List all email accounts (Gmail/Outlook accounts) in the system. Can optionally filter by account_id.

account_id.description: Optional account ID to filter email accounts

function.name: get_account_info
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific account (logged-in user) by their ID

account_id.description: The ID of the account to retrieve

function.name: get_email_account_info
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific email account (Gmail/Outlook) by its ID

email_account_id.description: The ID of the email account to retrieve

function.name: search_emails
function.description: Search emails using Gmail query syntax or semantic search. Use semantic=True for natural language queries.

query.description: Search query (Gmail syntax or natural language)

email_account_id.description: Optional email account ID to filter emails

function.name: sync_emails
function.description: Fetch new emails from Gmail for a specific email account and store them

email_account_id.description: The ID of the email account whose emails to sync

function.name: get_email_details
function.description: Get full details of a specific email by its message ID

function.name: get_email_account_emails
function.description: Get cached emails for a specific email account from the database

function.name: create_calendar_event
function.description: Create a new calendar event. Always uses the main calendar (email account ID 1). IMPORTANT: Always provide the date in YYYY-MM-DD format with the full year. Use the current date context provided in the system message to infer the correct year.

date.description: Event date in YYYY-MM-DD format. MUST include the full year (e.g., 2025-12-05, not 12-05). Use date context to infer the year if not specified by user.

time.description: Event time in HH:MM AM/PM format or 'All Day'

function.name: update_calendar_event
function.description: Update an existing calendar event. When updating the date, always use YYYY-MM-DD format with the full year.

date.description: New date in YYYY-MM-DD format. MUST include the full year (e.g., 2025-12-05).

function.name: get_calendar_events
function.description: Get calendar events for a date range from all calendars (primary + Moodle). If no dates provided, returns current month.

function.name: extract_dates_from_emails
function.description: Extract deadlines and important dates from recent emails using AI. Can optionally auto-create calendar events.

email_account_id.description: Email account ID whose emails to analyze

limit.description: Number of recent emails to analyze

function.name: summarize_emails
function.description: Generate AI summary of emails matching criteria

email_account_id.description: Optional email account ID to filter emails
